text:
maria: Quick sync — need prioritization for Optimize toolkit launch wedges. Pilot asks: adaptive per-route batching, tenant-aware KV-prefix caching, and a quantization recommender. Beta target: Q3. Who owns acceptance and what can be deferred?

ajay: Split must-have vs nice-to-have. push quant to nice-to-have if caching+batching hit >=25% token savings.

kelly: Customers want predictable p95 and clear cost delta. proposed acceptance:
MUST: batching+cache e2e on 2 pilot routes, p95 <=350ms, token cost reduction >=20%, zero user-visible errors.
NICE: quant recommender prototype with simulated accuracy delta <=1.5% on eval set.
ROLL: canary 5->25->100% with auto-rollback on SLI breaches.

sam: Cust A requires eval-triggered alerts: when quality drops on prompt set, send ops webhook + top-3 offending prompts. MVP behind flag.

maria: Agreed. Keep webhook lightweight.

tony: Ops: caching must preserve tenant isolation and PII opt-out. eviction TTLs should be configurable per-tenant/route. add kill-switch.

ajay: Implementation note: collect bucketed seq-length histograms per route and run offline optimizer to keep runtime simple.

kelly: For quant, ship simulator using small customer-representative eval set to reduce onboarding friction.

sam: Pilot plan: Cust A staging alpha 2w -> measure econ+latency -> enable eval-alerts -> quant opt-in.

ops-bot: @eng-infra assigned: caching-multi-tenant. ticket INF-6123 created.

maria: Dependencies: eng-infra for cache, eng-sre for hist metrics, eng-ml for scoring. Next steps: owners file tickets, draft pilot runbook + rollback playbook. 30-min sync tomorrow 10am.

ajay: I'll file batching ticket + hist RFC.

kelly: I'll draft acceptance PR and runbook.

sam: I'll schedule staging with Cust A.

tony: I'll prioritize kill-switch and TTL config.

maria: I'll consolidate scope doc after sync. :thumbsup:
